hints.title: Subset Sum Partitioning Obstacle
hints.text: Partitioning into two equal-sum subsets requires finding whether any subset sums to exactly half of the total sum. If the total sum is odd, no partition exists. How can you determine if target sum half exists without generating all exponential subsets?

hints.title: Half-Sum 0/1 Knapsack Invariant
hints.text: The problem is equivalent to 0/1 knapsack where items are array numbers and target capacity is sum(nums) / 2.

hints.title: Reachable Sum Set Expansion Procedure
hints.text: If the array sum is odd, return false immediately. Compute target = sum / 2. Initialize a set or boolean array with 0 as reachable. For each number, iterate through previously reachable sums and add the current number to each, inserting new reachable sums up to target. If target is reached, return true. If all numbers are processed without reaching target, return false.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of array nums (1 <= N <= 200)
complexity.notes: Pseudo-polynomial time complexity based on target half-sum and array length.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all 2^N subsets times out on arrays with over 30 elements.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Compressing the knapsack table to a 1D boolean array of size target + 1 takes only O(target) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Early exit for odd total sum, mapping to 0/1 knapsack with target = total / 2, reverse iteration to avoid reusing elements.
